# Velnix Solutions

> Velnix Solutions is an AI development and software development company building intelligent systems, AI agents, automation solutions, and scalable software products.

Velnix Solutions designs and builds intelligent software systems, AI agents, automation workflows, and scalable digital products for businesses.
